Anesthesia%20Technique:%20Neuraxial.description: This phenotype is used to determine whether or not a case included neuraxial anesthesia and if that neuraxial anesthesia was spinal, epidural, caudal, multiple types, combined spinal-epidural, or unknown. Anesthesia%20Technique:%20Peripheral%20N.description: This phenotype is used to determine if a peripheral nerve block was attempted or placed for a given case.

Anesthesia%20Technique:%20Sedation.description: This phenotype is used to determine if monitored anesthesia care was used during a case with or without sedation medications

Anesthetic%20Gases%20Reference%20Table.description: Reference table for thresholds of clinical significance for anesthetic gases (halogenated and nitrous).

Anti-hypertensive%20Infusion.description: This phenotype determines if a Anti-hypertensive was given as an infusion during a case between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

Antiemetics%20Given.description: This phenotype determines which antiemeetics were given during a case as well as the periopative phase they were administered.

Antimicrobials%20Given.description: This phenotype specifies which antimicrobials were given during a case as well as the periopative phase they were administered.

Arterial%20Line%20Used.description: To identify cases that have at least 20 valid blood pressure values taken from an invasive arterial line.

ASA%20Class.description: This phenotype returns the ASA classifcation assigned to a case based on collation mapping of raw text and numeric values documented within the electronic medical record. Blood%20Pressure%20Observations.description: This phenotype is used to determine the "primary" blood pressure for a given minute from the monitor data, as well as to cache derived metadata about each blood pressure.

Blood%20Product%20Total%20-%20Cryoprecip.description: This phenotype returns the total amount of cryoprecipitate administered per case in both milliliters and units.

Blood%20Product%20Total%20-%20FFP.description: This phenotype returns the total amount of fresh frozen plasma administered per case in both milliliters and units.

Blood%20Product%20Total%20-%20Platelets.description: This phenotype returns the total number of platelets administered per case in both milliliters and units.

Blood%20Product%20Total%20-%20PRBCs.description: This phenotype returns the total number of packed red blood cells administered per case in both milliliters and units between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

BMI.description:
Body Mass Index (BMI) Returns a continuous variable, with the limits of 10-80 as valid ranges of BMI. Anything outside these bounds are returned as the respective bound.

BMI calculation is reliant upon accurate patient height and weight data. Inaccurate height or weight patient data can cause an error in the reported BMI. Missing height or weight data will not return a value for BMI.

Data quality is limited to individual site documentation accuracy, completeness, and variable mapping, which is performed by each site, independently. MPOG, as the coordinating center, reviews data quality at each data upload and monthly via Data Diagnostics and Case Validation tools. This review, while thorough, may not contain all data elements relevant to this phenotype and thus should be carefully reviewed by the user.

BMI%20Classification%20(Pediatric).description: This collation is used to determine the body mass index (BMI) percentile based on the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) classification for patients ages 2 - 19 years old.

return_columns.Healthy Weight: 5th percentile to less than the 85th percentile

BMI%20Percentile%20(Pediatric).description: This phenotype determines the BMI-for-age percentile and associated z-score for patients 2 - 19 years old.

Carbon%20Footprint_GWP20.description: Total carbon footprint per case for the maintenance period of anesthesia. Reported as kg CO2 equivalents based on GWP20 values for inhaled anesthestic agents.

Cardiopulmonary%20Bypass%20End.description: This phenotype returns the latest date/time of cardiopulmonary bypass specific concepts for each case.

Cardiopulmonary%20Bypass%20Start.description: This phenotype determines the start date/time a patient is on full cardiopulmonary bypass.

Cesarean%20Delivery%20Start%20Time%20for.description: This phenotype will be used to determine the pseudo case start time for the cesarean delivery portion of obstetric labor epidural cases that convert to cesarean delivery.

Data%20Capture%20End.description: This phenotype returns the date/time physiologic data capture has ended for a case.

Data%20Capture%20Start.description: This phenotype returns the date/time physiologic data capture has started for a case.

Days%20Since%20Last%20Case.description: This phenotype returns the number of days it has been since the last case associated with a patient related to every case.

Diagnoses%20Cleaned%20Aggregated.description: This phenotype collects and returns all of the diagnosis codes for a case.

Duration%20of%20Anesthesiology%20Residen.description: Duration of time (minutes) that anesthesiology resident(s) are signed into the case between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

Duration%20of%20CRNA%20and%20Anesthesia%.description: Duration of time (minutes) that Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist(s) or Anesthesia Assistant(s) are signed into the case between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

Endotracheal%20Tube.description: This collation determines if the case involves a general anesthetic with an endotracheal tube (GA_ETT = yes/no) attempted.  If any LMA note is placed (LMA attempted) this phenotype will return a "no"(0), unless there was a paralytic used in the case, in which case "yes"(1) would be returned.

Extubation%20Times.description: Returns the time of any note or note detail that suggests an extubation during the case.

First%20In%20Room%20Blood%20Pressure.description: The first non-artifact Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) associated with the first non-artifact blood pressure containing both systolic and diastolic blood pressure values between Patient In Room and Patient Out of Room. If a blood pressure MAP value is not recorded then it will be computed based on the systolic and diastolic pressure values. Calculate mean arterial pressure (MAP) using this equation: (BaselineBloodPressureSystolic)*1/3 + (BaselineBloodPressureDiastolic)*2/3

Gestational%20Age%20at%20Birth.description: This phenotype determines if a case was performed on a patient that was born prematurely.

Glucose%20Observations%20Perioperative.description: This phenotype is used to return any glucose measurements associated with a case from the start of preoperative care through the end of care in the post-anesthesia care unit.

Induction%20Start.description: This phenotype returns the associated date/time of Induction Start for cases as applicable.

Induction%20Type.description: This phenotype determines the induction technique used per case.

Induction%20Type%20Notes.description: This phenotype returns all induction type and anesthesia technique notes documented on a case. One case can have multiple 'types' of induction as this phenotype returns all raw text/numeric values within AIMS variables mapped to specific MPOG concepts.

Inhalational%20Anesthetic%20Duration.description: This phenotype determines the duration (in minutes) a patient recieved an inhalational anesthetic including halogenated gases and nitrous gases.

Inotrope%20Infusion.description: This phenotype determines if a inotrope was given as an infusion during a case between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

Institution%20Region.description: This phenotype identifies the geographic region within the United States of the primary building associated with each MPOG institution.  The four regions - Northeast, Midwest, South, and West - are determined by the U.S. Census Bureau and used by the CDC (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/hus/sources-definitions/geographic-region.htm).

Intentional%20Hypothermia.description: This phenotype determines if intentional hypothermia occurred during a case.

Intraoperative%20MAP%20(Minutes%20Under%.description: Calculates the number of minutes during a case that the patient's Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) was under 65mmHg.

Intraoperative%20Research%20Standard.description: Binary variable indicating whether a case meets the Intraoperative Research Standard as defined in the Logic section below.

Intubated%20Awake%20(for%20fiberoptic).description: This phenotype is used exclusively for fiberoptics. Please use in parallel with the "Intubated Fiberoptic" phenotype if you are looking to discover awake fiberoptic cases.

Intubated%20Fiberoptic.description: The Intubated Fiberoptic phenotype will indicate whether or not a fiberoptic scope was used during intubation and whether the attempt was Nasal, Oral, Unspecified, or Unknown - DLT (Double Lumen Tube).  This phenotype should be paired to the "Intubated Awake" phenotype to investigate Awake Fiberoptic intubation attempts.

Intubation%20Time.description: This phenotype returns the earliest date/time of ETT or LMA placement documented between Anesthesia Start and Procedure Start.

Is%20Valid%20Case.description: Used to determine if an anesthesia case meets the minimum requirements to be considered valid

IV%20Infusion%20Minutes.description: This phenotype returns the name of each IV medication infusion (via Concept ID) and the number of minutes the infusion was ran between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

Last%20Known%20Alive.description: This phenotype returns the last known date that the patient was considered alive according to MPOG data.  It is used to help determine the date of death and Mortality data

Legal%20Sex.description: Provides the documented Legal Sex for each case.

Length%20of%20Stay%20After%20Procedure%2.description: This phenotype uses administrative billing codes to calculate postoperative length of stay.

LMA%20Removal%20Times.description: This phenotype returns the date/time of intraoperative notes that suggest an LMA was removed during a case.

Location%20Tags.description: This phenotype returns the location tag that was assigned (or inherited based on location heiarchy) to the operating/procedure room that a case was completed in.

Lowest%20Hemoglobin!Hematocrit%20During%.description: This phenotype obtains the lowest valid hemoglobin (or hematocrit converted to hemoglobin) between Anesthesia Start and Anesthesia End.

Measure:%20NMB-05.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of cases with documentation of train-of-four count or ratio provided by a quantitative monitor (acceleromyography, electromyography, kinemyography, or mechanomyography)

Measure:%20PAIN-01%20(PEDS).description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients < 18 years old who undergo a surgical or therapeutic procedure and receive a non-opioid adjunct preoperatively or intraoperatively.

Measure:%20PAIN-02.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients ≥ 18 years old who undergo a surgical or therapeutic procedure and receive a non-opioid adjunct preoperatively and/or intraoperatively.

Measure:%20PONV-03.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients, regardless of age, who undergo a procedure and have a documented nausea/emesis occurrence OR receive a rescue antiemetic in the immediate postoperative period.

Measure:%20PONV-03b.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients, regardless of age who undergo a procedure and have a documented nausea/emesis occurrence with or without receiving an antiemetic in the immediate postoperative period.

Measure:%20PONV-04%20(PEDS).description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients 3 through 17 years of age, who receive appropriate antiemetic prophylaxis preoperatively and/or intraoperatively

Measure:%20PONV-05.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients 18 years of age or older, who receive appropriate antiemetic prophylaxis preoperatively and/or intraoperatively

Measure:%20PUL-01.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of cases with median tidal volumes less than 10ml/kg.

Measure:%20SMOK-01.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients, ≥18 years of age, with smoking status documented within 30 days prior to any procedure requiring anesthesia

Measure:%20SMOK-02.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients, ≥18 years of age, who are documented as current tobacco smokers and also receive an approved smoking cessation intervention from an anesthesia provider

Measure:%20SUS-02.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of cases where carbon dioxide equivalents (CO2 eq) normalized by hour for cases receiving halogenated agents and/or nitrous oxide is less than CO2 eq of 2% sevoflurane at 2L FGF = 2.83 kg CO2/hr during the maintenance period of anesthesia OR the Total CO2e is less than 2.83 kg CO2.

Measure:%20SUS-03.description: ASPIRE Measure: Total carbon dioxide equivalents per induction for cases where halogenated agents and/or nitrous oxide was administered during the induction period of anesthesia

Measure:%20TEMP-01.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of cases that active warming was administered by the anesthesia provider.

Measure:%20TEMP-02.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of cases with increased risk of hypothermia that the anesthesia provider documented at least one core temperature intraoperatively for any patient receiving a general anesthetic.

Measure:%20TEMP-03.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients, regardless of age, who undergo surgical or therapeutic procedures under general or neuraxial anesthesia of 60 minutes duration or longer for whom at least one body temperature greater than or equal to 36 degrees Celsius (or 96.8 degrees Fahrenheit) was recorded within the 30 minutes immediately before or the 15 minutes immediately after anesthesia end time

Measure:%20TEMP-04%20(PEDS).description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients < 18 years old who undergo any procedure greater than 30 minutes and have a Median core/near core body temperature > 36C (96.8F)

Measure:%20TEMP-05%20(OB).description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients who undergo cesarean deliveries under general or neuraxial anesthesia for whom no body temperature was greater than or equal to 36 degrees Celsius (or 96.8 F) recorded within the 30 minutes immediately before or the 15 minutes immediately after the case

Measure:%20TEMP-06%20(Cardiac).description: Percentage of patients, ≥18 years age, who undergo open cardiac surgical procedures under general anesthesia of 120 minutes duration or longer for whom last non-artifact body temperature measure at the end of the case was not greater than or equal to 35.5 degrees Celsius (or 95.9 degrees Fahrenheit). (Reported as an inverse measure: lower is better.)

Measure:%20TEMP-07%20(Cardiac).description: Percentage of patients, ≥18 years age, who undergo open cardiac surgical procedures using cardiopulmonary bypass under general anesthesia of 120 minutes case duration (anesthesia start to anesthesia end) or longer for whom the temperature did not rise above 37.5 degrees Celsius (99.5 degrees Fahrenheit) while on bypass for over 5 consecutive minutes.

Measure:%20TOC-01.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients who undergo a procedure under anesthesia in which a permanent intraoperative anesthesia staff change occurred, who have a documented use of a checklist or protocol for the transfer of care from the responsible anesthesia practitioner to the next responsible anesthesia practitioner.

Measure:%20TOC-02.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients, regardless of age, who are under the care of an anesthesia practitioner and are admitted to a PACU in which a post-anesthetic formal transfer of care protocol or checklist which includes the key transfer of care elements is utilized.

Measure:%20TOC-03.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of patients, regardless of age, who undergo a procedure under anesthesia and are admitted to an Intensive Care Unit (ICU) directly from the anesthetizing location, who have a documented use of a checklist or protocol for the transfer of care from the responsible anesthesia practitioner to the responsible ICU team or team member

Measure:%20TRAN-01.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of cases with a blood transfusion that have a hemoglobin or hematocrit value documented prior to transfusion.

Measure:%20TRAN-02.description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage of cases with a post transfusion hemoglobin or hematocrit value less than or equal to 10 g/dL or 30%.

Measure:%20TRAN-03%20(PEDS).description: ASPIRE Measure: Percentage pediatric surgical cases with a blood transfusion that have a hemoglobin or hematocrit value documented prior to transfusion.

Obstetric%20Anesthesia%20Type.description: This collation will be used to determine if cases with predicted or actual CPT codes for labor epidurals, cesarean deliveries, or cesarean hysterectomies (01961, 01967, 01968, 19969, or 01963) are one of eight case types: labor epidural, cesarean delivery, labor epidural converted to cesarean delivery, cesarean hysterectomy, conversion (labor epidural portion), conversion (cesarean delivery portion), conversion (cesarean hysterectomy portion) or unable to determine. High variability in use of CPT codes and frequent mismatches between CPT codes and procedures performed necessitate this phenotype. This phenotype will be used to include or exclude cases from obstetric specific measures and other general measures.

Obstetric%20Neuraxial%20Anesthesia%20Sta.description: This phenotype is used to determine the start time of neuraxial anesthesia for obstetric delivery cases.  Obstetric delivery cases are first identified using the Obstetric Anesthesia Type Phenotype. Neuraxial start times will result for both vaginal delivery cases that have documentation of a labor epidural and for cesarean delivery cases.

Opioids%20Given.description: This phenotype specifies which opioids were given during a case as well as the perioperative phase opioid medication(s) were administered.

Oral%20Morphine%20Equivalent.description: This phenotype takes the opioid medications given for a case and converts them into oral morphine equivalents, expressed in milligrams oral morphine.  This phenotype also returns whether an opioid medication was documented as given but was not included in the OME for the case due to lack of dosing information (labeled as "unknown").  For example, if 10mg IV morphine was recorded and an unknown dose of IV fentanyl, the case would return the OME for the morphine and "unknown" as a 1, indicating another opioid medication was given and not included in the OME calculation.  Additionally, this phenotype returns whether Remifentanyl was included as the current OME converion used is 0.

Procedure%20Type:%20Cystoscopy.description: This phenotype determines whether a case had a Cystoscopy procedure using logic based upon a combination of Anesthesia CPT codes and procedure text.  Procedures such as biopsies, lithotripsies, and stent insertion/removal will be included in the cystoscopy only bucket.

Procedure%20Type:%20Diagnostic%20Imaging.description: This phenotype deterimines if the case had a CT, MRI, MRA, PET scan, or TEE done.  It also will determine if it was only a scan/imaging or if there was an additional procedure.

Procedure%20Type:%20ECT.description: This phenotype determines if a case was electroconvulsive therapy (ECT).

Procedure%20Type:%20Endoscopy.description: This phenotype determines whether a case was a Endoscopy related procedure or Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) using logic based upon a combination of Surgical CPT codes and procedure text.

Procedure%20Type:%20Hip%20Arthroplasty.description: This phenotype determines whether a case had a Hip Replacement procedure using logic based upon a combination of Anesthesia CPT codes and procedure text.

Procedure%20Type:%20Intubation%20Only.description: This phenotype is used to determine if the primary procedure of a case was placement of an endotracheal tube.

Procedure%20Type:%20IVF.description: This phenotype is used to determine if a case is an IVF procedure.

Procedure%20Type:%20Kidney%20Transplant.description: This phenotype determines whether the case is a kidney transplant using logic based upon a combination of anesthesia CPT codes, surgical CPT codes, procedure text and surgical service. This phenotype considers both actual CPT codes and predicted CPT codes (when actual CPT is missing for a case). The phenotype returns a Yes/No value code; for cases flagged as a Yes, the phenotype will also return the associated source text that triggered the Yes value.

Procedure%20Type:%20Knee%20Arthroplasty.description: This phenotype determines whether a case had a Knee Replacement procedure using logic based upon a combination of Anesthesia CPT codes and procedure text.

Procedure%20Type:%20Liver%20Transplant.description: This phenotype determines whether the case is a liver transplant recipient using logic based upon a combination of anesthesia CPT codes, surgical CPT codes, procedure text and surgical service. This phenotype considers both actual CPT codes and predicted CPT codes (when actual CPT is missing for a case). The phenotype returns a Yes/No value code; for cases flagged as a Yes, the phenotype will also return the associated source text that triggered the Yes value.

Procedure%20Type:%20Lung%20Transplant.description: This phenotype determines whether the case is a lung transplant using logic based upon a combination of surgical CPT codes, procedure text and surgical service.The phenotype returns a Yes/No value code; for cases flagged as a Yes, the phenotype will also return the associated source text that triggered the Yes value.

Procedure%20Type:%20Middle%20Ear%20Proce.description: This phenotype determines if a case includes tympanoplasty using logic based upon a combination of surgical CPT codes and procedure text.

Propofol%20Infusion.description: Determines if the propofol infusion was a meaningful part of the anesthesia technique for the case. Includes both a dose-based requirement of at least 40 mcg/kg/min or equivalent and a time-based requirement of at least 50% of case duration.

Propofol%20Infusion%20(Minutes%20Used)%2.description: This phenotype calcuates the number of minutes Propofol was used during a case.

Pulse%20Rate%20Observations.description: This phenotype is used to determine the "pulse" given minute from the monitor data, as well as to cache derived metadata about each pulse.

Race%20(Multiple%20Value%20Per%20Case).description: This phenotype assesses a case using a hierarchical decision tree to determine matched Race enumerations with 'Patient Attributes - Race' and 'Race and Ethnicities' concepts. If multiple concepts are used within a concept type, each will be returned on a separate row.

Race%20(Single%20Value%20Per%20Case).description: This phenotype assesses a case using a hierarchical decision tree to determine matched Race enumerations with 'Patient Attributes - Race' and 'Race and Ethnicities' concept types. If multiple concepts are used within a concept type, "Multiracial" will be returned on a single row.

Sex%20(Source%20Undefined).description: Provides the documented Sex (Source Undefined) for each case.

Sex%20Assigned%20at%20Birth.description: Provides the documented Sex Assigned at Birth for each case.

Smoking%20Tobacco%20Classification%20(ne.description: Classification to determine non-smoker, former smoker, or current smoker. This collation only considers tobacco smoking status, not marijuana or other substances. Use of smokeless tobacco products, including chewing tobacco, are classified as ‘non-smoker.’ Smokeless tobacco products are classified in a separate phenotype.

Smoking%20Tobacco%20Notes.description: The Smoking Tobacco Notes phenotype returns the raw source value documented under the AIMS variables mapped to preoperative MPOG concept subsets: 'Smoking Tobacco Notes (Definite)' and 'Smoking Tobacco Notes (Ambiguous)'.

SpO2%20Observations.description: This phenotype is used to determine the "primary" SpO2 for a given minute from the monitor data.

Staff%20Roles.description: Returns staff ID and associated staff type for a given case.

return_columns.SRNA: Staff Level - Student Registered Nurse Anesthetist (SRNA)

Starting%20Provider.description: Returns all anesthesia providers signed into the case two minutes after anesthesia start.

STS%20-%20Adult%20Cardiac%20Surgery%20Da.description: This phenotype matches MPOG Cases to the STS Adult Cardiac Surgery (ACSD) Registry database.

STS%20-%20General%20Thoracic%20Surgery%2.description: This phenotype matches MPOG Cases to the STS General Thoracic Surgery (GTSD) Registry database.

Surgery%20Duration.description: This phenotype is used to determine the length of procedure in minutes.

Surgery%20End%20Date!Time.description: Return the documented date/time of documented procedure/surgery end.

Surgery%20Start%20Date!Time.description: This phenotype returns the documented date/time of procedure start for each case.  One value per case.

Surgical%20CPT%20(Primary).description: Returns a single Surgical CPT (if available) per case. If there are multiple, takes the Sugical CPT with the highest base unit after crosswalk to anesthesiology CPT codes.

Surgical%20CPTs%20(All).description: Returns all of the surgical CPTs listed for each individual operative case.

Surgical%20Service.description: This phenotype returns the surgical service assigned to a case.

Tidal%20Volume%20Actual.description: This collation returns all values and times of tidal volume actual readings associated with a case.

Tidal%20Volume%20Actual%20(Median).description: Returns a single value as the median for the Tidal Volume Actual (MPOG concept id: 3190) for a case, among valid tidal volumes.

Tidal%20Volume%20Set.description: This collation is used to return all readings of set tidal volume assocciated wtih a case

Tidal%20Volume%20Set%20(Median).description: Median for the Tidal Volume Set (MPOG concept id: 3192) for a case, among valid tidal volumes.

Total%20Colloid%20Administered.description: This phenotype sums of all Colloids used during the intraoperative timeframe of a specific case in mls.

Total%20Crystalloid%20Administered.description: This phenotype sums of all Crystalloids used during the intraoperative timeframe of a specific case in mls.

Total%20Estimated%20Blood%20Loss%20(EBL).description: This returns in mL the sum of all recorded Estimated Blood Loss for the case as charted in the Intraoperative Record for a given case.

Total%20Urine%20Output.description: Converts values to mL and sums to total. Returns is capped to values between 0 - 20,000 mL.

Train%20Of%20Four%20Values.description: This phenotype returns the Train-of-four values documented during a case.

Units%20Transfused.description: This phenotype is used to sum all units of blood transfused on a case between 'Anesthesia Start' and 'Anesthesia End'

US%20Institution.description: This phenotype returns yes/no based on whether the institution where the case took place is based in the United States or not.

Vasopressor%20Bolus.description: This phenotype determines if a vasopressor was given as a bolus during a case between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

Vasopressor%20Infusion.description: This phenotype determines if a vasopressor was given as an infusion during a case between anesthesia start and anesthesia end.

Ventilation%20During%20Intraop.description: This phenotype is used for ASPIRE Pulmonary measures. This phenotype determines how many minutes of ventilation are on a case by measuring how many minutes of tidal volume are documented during the case.

Ventilator%20Start%20Time.description: Returns the first time during a case if/when the patient is mechanically ventilated.

Waiting%20For%20Transport%20Duration.description: This phenotype returns the duration (minutes) from procedure end to when a patient is transported out of the procedure room.

Warming%20Method%20Classification.description: This phenotype returns the warming method assigned to a case based on collation mapping of raw text and numeric values documented within the electronic medical record. These data include AIMS variables mapped to 'Warming Method Notes' concept subset. Collation mapping is completed at the MPOG Coordinating Center.

Weight%20(kg).description: Cleaned AIMS Weight and converted to kilograms (if needed)

Weight%20for%20Age.description: This phenotype determines the z-score and the associated weight-for-age percentile for patients from birth to 2 years old.

WHO%20BMI%20Classification.description: This collation is used to determine the body mass index (BMI) based on the World Health Organization classification
